name: RadioGroup
description:
The Radio component allows users to select one option from a set of choices.

Wrap `<Radio>` items (also available as `RadioGroup.Radio`) in a `<RadioGroup>` for labeled radios with the Cerberus control, or compose the primitives for full structural control. The group supports a horizontal or vertical orientation and two sizes; a single radio can override the size. To use it within a form, wrap it with the Fieldset or Field component.

parts.description: An abstraction that renders a single labeled radio item with the Cerberus control and its hidden input

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of the checked radio when rendered. Use when you don't need to control the value of the radio group.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the input fields in the radio (Useful for form submission).

props.name: invalid
